avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer; decreases sirolimus levels by 50-60%, reducing immunosuppressive efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; do not use concurrently; monitor trough levels if recently discontinued

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases sirolimus bioavailability and peak levels, risking toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; consider alternative citrus fruits; maintain consistent intake if unavoidable

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin-containing supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer; dramatically reduces sirolimus levels below therapeutic range
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; use alternative antimicrobial agents; monitor levels closely

avoid_supplements.name: Milk Thistle (Silymarin)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; may increase sirolimus concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel on risk of elevated drug levels and adverse effects

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer; may reduce sirolimus efficacy and immunosuppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid during transplant maintenance; use alternative immune support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibitor; theoretical potential to increase sirolimus levels
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; monitor for signs of toxicity; no absolute contraindication at culinary doses

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 inhibition; may marginally increase sirolimus exposure
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe at dietary levels; excessive supplementation should be discussed with provider

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minimal direct interaction; may enhance antiplatelet effects and increase bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for bleeding; use standard doses; inform provider of supplementation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor in juice and pulp; significantly increases sirolimus AUC and Cmax
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate completely from diet; educate on hidden sources in juices and fresh fruit

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; increases sirolimus bioavailability similar to grapefruit
avoid_foods.action: Avoid pomegranate and pomegranate juice; consider alternative fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases sirolimus absorption and bioavailability; may elevate drug levels
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary fat intake; take sirolimus consistently with or without food

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains indoles that are mild CYP3A4 inducers; minimal clinical effect at normal intake
caution_foods.action: No restriction needed; maintain consistent consumption patterns

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May impair liver function and increase infection risk in immunosuppressed patients
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate consumption; counsel on infection risk and drug metabolism

monitoring_notes: Maintain consistent dietary habits and obtain baseline/regular sirolimus trough levels (5-15 ng/mL target range varies by indication). Monitor renal function, lipid panel, and CBC regularly as sirolimus carries risks of nephrotoxicity, hyperlipidemia, and myelosuppression independent of food/supplement interactions.
